shots.action_description: Camera pans right across the warm edit suite, revealing camera rigs, dual monitors, practical lamps, and film reels.
shots.visual_prompt: A spacious cinema edit suite bathed in golden practical light, with camera equipment, color grading screens, warm lamps, and stacked film reels.
shots.voiceover_line: Every tool runs locally—no cloud fees, no subscriptions.

shots.action_description: Instructor leans toward the monitor, smiling, gesturing with his hand as he explains the workflow.
shots.visual_prompt: A charismatic filmmaker with wavy brown hair, beard, black sweater, standing at a workstation, warm light rimming his face.
shots.voiceover_line: One agent per job, human approves each gate before next stage.

shots.action_description: Monitor displays icons of Ollama, Blender, ComfyUI, Whisper, Kdenlive, and OpenTimelineIO in a grid.
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of a computer screen showing six software icons labeled Ollama, Blender, ComfyUI, Whisper, Kdenlive, OpenTimelineIO, each marked free.
shots.voiceover_line: The stack: Ollama, Blender, ComfyUI, Whisper, Kdenlive, OpenTimelineIO—free.

shots.action_description: Camera tilts up from the plush carpet to the projector beam slicing through soft haze, revealing a vintage clapperboard on a side table.
shots.visual_prompt: Intimate arthouse screening room with warm wood walls, a projector casting a golden beam, ambient haze, and a wooden clapperboard.
shots.voiceover_line: Our 7‑point audit needs a human signature before release.

shots.action_description: Instructor looks directly into the camera, warm smile, gesturing invitingly toward the audience.
shots.visual_prompt: Instructor standing near the screen, soft rim light outlining his silhouette, eyes locked on the camera.
shots.voiceover_line: Join Tuesday Cinema Club summit 10/24/26—learn pipeline, build spot.

shots.action_description: Phone on a desk shows a bright app screen with a 'Clone Starter Kit' button and QR code.
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of a smartphone displaying a download page for the local starter kit, with a large button and QR code, warm lighting reflecting off the screen.
shots.voiceover_line: No code needed—your phone works, replacing $840 Adobe plan free.
